name: Sugimiya Takeshi
source: Osamu's eldest son who is withdrawn and antagonistic toward everyone around him, and is overtly rebellious against his father. What is the source of his troublesome nature, and will Heikichi able to open up this young man's heart?
translation: 修的长子。他性格孤僻，对身边所有人都抱有敌意，也公然反抗父亲。他麻烦不断的性格究竟源自何处？平吉能否打开这个年轻人的心扉？
